# Jubilees Chapter 29 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 29:10 — "mercies and faithfulness" vs. "steadfast love and faithfulness"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "all the mercies and all the faithfulness" | Literal rendering of each noun individually |
| LOGOS | "all the steadfast love and faithfulness" | "Steadfast love" renders hesed per project convention |
| PNEUMA | omits the hendiadys | Compresses to "all of this" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. "Steadfast love" is established by project convention for hesed (cf. Genesis chapters). PNEUMA's compression loses the covenantal weight of this prayer, which is programmatic.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 29:18 — "struck" vs. "wrenched" vs. "touched"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "struck the socket of his hip" | Literal force verb from Ge'ez |
| LOGOS | "struck the socket of Jacob's hip" | Same; preserves active violence |
| PNEUMA | "wrenched Jacob's hip out of its socket" | Explains the anatomical result dynamically |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "struck the socket." The Ge'ez verb implies a precise striking, not a full dislocation wrenching. PNEUMA's elaboration ("out of its socket") goes beyond the Ge'ez.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 29:20 — the name change formula

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Thy name shall no more be called Jacob" | Archaic formal register |
| LOGOS | "Your name will no longer be Jacob" | Modern formal |
| PNEUMA | "Not anymore. Your name is Israel" | Fragmented for dramatic effect |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. The formal register is appropriate for a divine name-change oracle. PNEUMA's fragmentation into sentence fragments loses the solemnity of the moment.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 29:24 — "sinew of the hip" vs. "sciatic nerve"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "sinew of the hip" | Literal Ge'ez rendering of the anatomical term |
| LOGOS | "sinew of the hip that is at the socket" | More anatomically precise |
| PNEUMA | "sciatic nerve" | Modern anatomical equivalent |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "sinew of the hip that is at the socket." The Ge'ez is explicit about the location without using modern anatomical nomenclature. PNEUMA's "sciatic nerve" is anachronistic.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
